# Automate me

A guided flow for turning the user's working conventions into a skill agents will follow. The output is one `-mode` skill tailored to them such as `jay-mode` or `priya-mode`.

This flow sequences history min
scope: This is a source read by the case batch coordinator. It is not represented as a child worker read or as proof of all child instructions.
clock: The public event has no timestamp. Line order is retained. No duration or clock interval is inferred.
transformation: Exact event fields selected. Absolute task and installed-package paths are replaced with declared placeholders. Output is a prefix, not the complete source read. No other event or browser context is included. Only these literal or explicitly loop-listed registered source names are matched. This does not prove every registered source path was read. Native callable metadata is corroborated against a scoped private callsite. Protected or unrelated payload contents are not copied or decoded.

nativeCallBinding.corroboration: The actual scoped native custom-tool call invokes tools.exec_command with the exact command parsed from this public command_execution event. Only the callable identity and locator are projected. Its surrounding payload remains private.
